notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
The Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
